mappingRecordDraft.unknownOrMissing: reject presentation activation; preserve already committed business success

sourceEventDraft.identity: eventId deduplicates delivery; sourceKind+businessInstanceId deduplicates business completion even with new eventId

sourceEventDraft.timeDomain: must be explicit and trusted; receivedAt is diagnostic only; never infer live completion from recency alone
sourceEventDraft.currentV1Compatibility: required fields are NOT all present in V1; adapter contract upgrade required
sourceEventDraft.sourceInstanceMeaning: stable business namespace/producer identity, NOT reconnect, process or delivery epoch
sourceEventDraft.deliveryGeneration: separate transport lifecycle token; never part of business dedup identity
sourceEventDraft.businessInstanceIdMeaning: semantic completion instance/incarnation, not raw reusable V1 occurrenceId; upstream identity/revision adapter required; genuine new completion must not be permanently suppressed

sourceRecordDraft.routineDeadline: effectiveCompletedAt + explicit preset duration; proposed correction/recomplete cap=current firstAcceptedDeadline
sourceRecordDraft.unsupported: business transaction remains valid; theme presentation unsupported/ineligible; no rollback
sourceRecordDraft.expiry: fact clock, independent from visible animation freeze

aggregationDraft.active: any eligible nonrevoked source with now < currentDeadline
aggregationDraft.displayUntil: max currentDeadline among currently valid sources; projection only, not sole stored timer
aggregationDraft.merge: union independent sources; never additive duration; feed never overwrites routine
aggregationDraft.revoke: matching source or authorized validity manager only; recompute union
aggregationDraft.detectionOff: revoke detection-derived facts only; leave routine/feed/manual sources intact

idempotencyDraft.duplicateEvent: no new source; no duration reset
idempotencyDraft.newEventSameBusinessInstance: reconcile version; never new lifetime from delivery identity alone
idempotencyDraft.recovery: restore previously accepted source ledger with original deadline and remaining eligibility only; no new full duration; automatic visual reappearance policy pending
idempotencyDraft.retention: durable bounded strategy coordinated with business redelivery/history windows; exact limits unchosen
idempotencyDraft.mappingChanged: do not retroactively activate previously handled unsupported events
idempotencyDraft.ledgerOrdering: global handled business-instance ledger checked before theme/mapping/source projection; changed delivery generation cannot bypass it
idempotencyDraft.newHistoryImport: history/recovery import of events never previously accepted cannot create current theme activation under proposed history policy
idempotencyDraft.routineIdentityBoundary: same semantic completion is idempotent; raw occurrenceId reuse after undo may denote genuine new completion and cannot be decided by renderer

presentationDraft.sparseAction: optional separately approved opportunity/cooldown/budget; no loop or catch-up backlog by default
presentationDraft.actionCannot: reexecute routine completion, feeding, inventory mutation, extend source TTL, or consume another source
presentationDraft.lateAssetResult: reject expired/revoked/stale generation and release leases
